sql:
SELECT
    s.StoreKey,
    s.StoreName,
    sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, toYear(fos.DateKey) = 2009 AND toQuarter(fos.DateKey) = 3) AS q3_2009_sales,
    sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, toYear(fos.DateKey) = 2009 AND toQuarter(fos.DateKey) = 4) AS q4_2009_sales,
    q4_2009_sales - q3_2009_sales AS sales_change,
    (q4_2009_sales - q3_2009_sales) * 100.0 / nullIf(q3_2009_sales, 0) AS pct_change_q3_to_q4
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s
    ON fos.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
WHERE toYear(fos.DateKey) = 2009
  AND toQuarter(fos.DateKey) IN (3, 4)
GROUP BY
    s.StoreKey,
    s.StoreName
HAVING q4_2009_sales < q3_2009_sales
ORDER BY pct_change_q3_to_q4 ASC, sales_change ASC, s.StoreKey ASC
